text:
Evidence supports testing the loss before increasing capacity. [gSASRec (IJCAI 2024)](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/0939.pdf) attributes SASRec weaknesses to overconfidence induced by negative sampling; recommends generalized BCE with 128–256 negatives and correction parameter t=0.75. [eSASRec (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06450) identifies sampled softmax combined with SASRec’s autoregressive objective and improved Transformer layers as a strong configuration. These findings motivate a controlled loss-only comparison; they do not establish that Electronics specifically suffers from easy negatives.

Hardness needs safeguards. [R2NS (WWW 2026)](https://renzhaochun.github.io/assets/pdf/WWW_2026_Camera_Ready.pdf) samples randomly from a top-ranked candidate set instead of always selecting the highest-scoring item, with progressively harder selection to mitigate false negatives. Practical ablation proposal: uniform multi-negative sampled softmax first, then a mixture of uniform and moderately hard negatives after warm-up; exclude padding, target collisions, and known training positives from negative pools. These exclusions cannot identify every unobserved relevant item. For popularity or in-batch sampling, [Correcting the LogQ Correction (RecSys 2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09331) shows that proposal correction must account for the positive being included deterministically; sampling-bias correction is distinct from false-negative correction.

Compare baseline BCE, multi-negative BCE, gBCE, and sampled softmax with architecture held fixed, reporting GPU cost and per-category HR@10 alongside the four-category macro average. Select using the unchanged pinned validation protocol: 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, seed 42. Training margins alone cannot establish improvement. [Sampled-metric research](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/0651.pdf) shows sampled evaluation can reverse full-catalog model rankings, so gains here support this benchmark objective without establishing better full-catalog recommendations.
